issues.detail: Cold open claims '40-50K lost in hidden charges over 5 years on a 10K/month SIP'. At 1.5% expense ratio on a 10K/month SIP over 5 years (~7.3L corpus), total expenses would be roughly 5-7K per year, or 25-35K total. The 40-50K figure may be inflatable depending on assumptions but is not transparently derived. Needs manual verification.
